def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    electric_vehicle_patches = image_patch.find("electric vehicle")
    zebra_crossing_patches = image_patch.find("zebra crossing")
    
    if not electric_vehicle_patches or not zebra_crossing_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    electric_vehicle_patches.sort(key=lambda ev: ev.horizontal_center)
    zebra_crossing_patches.sort(key=lambda zc: zc.horizontal_center)
    
    closest_zebra_crossing = min(zebra_crossing_patches, key=lambda zc: abs(zc.horizontal_center - electric_vehicle_patches[0].horizontal_center))
    
    return electric_vehicle_patches[0] if closest_zebra_crossing.overlaps_with(electric_vehicle_patches[0].left, electric_vehicle_patches[0].lower, electric_vehicle_patches[0].right, electric_vehicle_patches[0].upper) else image_patch
